capture_method: local install (hermes 0.21.3) and the deployed 10.0.0.3 image hermes-agent:supersearch-lane-v26-20260928-r1, each run against a loopback capture server inside an isolated throwaway container/profile, fake key, synthetic prompt
provider: custom provider, api_mode chat_completions and codex_responses
notes: Only field presence and salted digest relations are recorded; raw session IDs, prompts, and Authorization are never stored.
chat_completions sent no session header and no prompt_cache_key.
codex_responses sent prompt_cache_key but no session header; Hermes' outbound Responses path does not emit an inbound session-affinity header.
Inbound X-Hermes-Session-Id is not echoed outbound.
The remote run used a disposable container with --network host and no production volumes; it never touched the live gateway state.

relations.resume: not captured for Hermes; session continuity is local and no outbound session-affinity field was observed to key it
relations.fork: not applicable to the captured surface
relations.compact: not captured; Hermes in-place compression keeps a logical scope but does not emit it as an HTTP affinity header
relations.gap: Hermes installed builds emit no session-affinity header, so gateway stickiness for Hermes requires either a client-side header feature or a body field such as prompt_cache_key with its weaker guarantees.
